editorial: When a weary father drags himself into a dating app, you feel the click of a new obsession. Succubus turns that banal swipe into a tense psychological maze where desire morphs into dread, showing how technology can become a portal to the supernatural. The unsettling performance of Sofia Ramos as the seductress keeps you on the edge, her silent gestures delivering more menace than any line. Fans of dark, cerebral thrillers who relish a story that blurs the lines between longing and horror will find themselves unsettled and engaged. The pacing slows in the third act, stretching the suspense past its welcome.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
